Commentary: Marco Jansen to Josh Hazlewood, leg byes, 1 run, slower and fuller, Hazlewood was bit early into the shot and it rapped on the pads outside the line
Marco Jansen to Nathan Ellis, 1 run, the slower short ball, Ellis mistimes it to long-on
Marco Jansen to Josh Hazlewood, no run, banged in short on the stumps, Hazlewood ducks under it
Marco Jansen to Josh Hazlewood, byes, 1 run, yorker length delivery from round the wicket, outside leg stump, Hazlewood backs away and misses it. They sneak a bye
Marco Jansen to Nathan Ellis, FOUR, touch shorter and angling across, Ellis stands tall and punches it off the back foot past the fielder to deep extra cover, split the gap to perfection!
Lizaad Williams to Josh Hazlewood, no run, shortish outside off, Hazlewood has a lazy waft at it and misses
Lizaad Williams to Josh Hazlewood, no run, banged in short and aimed at the body, Hazlewood flashes hard and misses it
Lizaad Williams to Josh Hazlewood, 1 run, full and on off, Hazlewood drags it off the inside half of the bat to mid-wicket
Lizaad Williams to Nathan Ellis, 1 run, back of a length and angling, Ellis taps it to cover

Lizaad Williams to Josh Hazlewood, out Caught by Aiden Markram!! It's all over, South Africa seal the series with one match to go. The slower delivery again, Hazlewood was beaten by the slowness of the ball and ends up miscuing a simple catch to mid-off. The South African players are over the moon. Josh Hazlewood c Aiden Markram b Lizaad Williams 2(10)
